sp_widget.name: HP WXP Alert App Setup
sp_widget.template:
App Setup

Run the initial setup to configure discovery sources, API connections, and integration settings.

Running setup...
{{log.name}} {{log.message}} For more details on how to configure
⚠️ Manual Fix Required

Create a new record:

  • Table: cmdb_ci_computer
  • Element: discovery_source
  • Label: HP Workforce Experience Platform
  • Value: HP Workforce Experience Platform
🔌 Connect HP WXP
  1. Login to WXP
  2. Go to Integrations
  3. Open ServiceNow Connector
  4. Click Connect
  5. Enter:
    • Instance URL
    • Username of user created in ServiceNow
    • Password of the same user

Required:

  • Application admin role: x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.admin
  • User created in ServiceNow with Identity type as Machine
